name: QWEN-WHOLE-0T
note: Executable projection of PRE-REG QWEN-WHOLE-0T (RESULTS L32776), same commit, registered BEFORE the compiler driver exists. Rate table B frozen by Artin 2026-08-17 04:02 from measured bridge-probe curves. Compiler-correctness rung only; MODEL-1 owns every functional question.

compiler.description: the single arm: scratch/qwen_whole0t.py per-shard transactional compression of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B@1d4bf0f2 under rate table B (FFN+attn projections W4@2.0625 per-tensor; embed+head S16@4.0625 per-tensor; small/special tensors passthrough bf16; vision and MTP excluded by named scope)

bars.name: CONSERVATION
bars.description: every source tensor key lands in exactly one of {compressed, passthrough, excluded-by-scope}; zero unknown, dropped, or duplicate keys, per shard and globally

bars.name: BUDGET
bars.description: total artifact bytes (payload + E8M0 scales + codebooks/alphabets + manifest) <= 7.5 GiB; table B predicts ~7.19 GiB plus overheads

bars.name: FIDELITY-SANITY
bars.description: compiler-bug tripwire: pooled per-family reconstruction op-error within 1.15x of the bridge-probe values (ffn 0.40, linear_attn 0.38, full_attn 0.39, embed+head 0.13); passing is NOT a quality claim

refuted_if: BAR 1 fails or the artifact exceeds 8 GiB: the bounded-compiler claim is false at rate table B and the whole-model program re-plans before MODEL-1.
registered_prior: House: all three bars FIRE. High confidence on 1 and 3 (the probes measured exactly these codecs on representative tensors of every family), medium-high on 2 (codebook/manifest overheads estimated, not measured).
